s.note: the bowl of rice Pai Mei knocks away
s.how: Wash 300g short grain rice until the water runs clear. Cook with 360ml water and 2 tbsp sake. Boil 4 eggs for 6 and a half minutes, cool and peel. Serve rice in small bowls with furikake, a pickled plum and a halved egg.

s.note: Budd's run-down trailer in the desert
s.how: Warm 375ml evaporated milk until steaming, then stir in 250g grated cheddar until smooth. Add 2 tbsp pickled jalapeño juice and a few chopped jalapeños. Pour into plastic bowls with corn chips and 100g beef jerky on the side.

m.how: Cut 1.2kg pork shoulder into big chunks and simmer slowly in 500g lard with 1 halved orange, 4 garlic cloves, 2 bay leaves and salt for 3 hours. Crisp in a hot pan. Char 400g tomatillos with a chilli, blitz with coriander. Serve in 16 warm tortillas.

w.how: Beat 150g butter with 120g sugar and 1 egg, add 1 tsp almond extract, then 220g flour, 50g almond meal and 1 tsp baking powder. Roll into 20 balls, press an almond into each, brush with egg and bake at 175C for 14 minutes.

d.how: Mix 2 tbsp salt with 1 tsp chilli powder on a plate. Rub the rims of four tall glasses with lime and dip in the salt, then fill with ice. Into each glass pour 45ml blanco tequila, 60ml fresh pink grapefruit juice, 15ml lime juice and 10ml agave syrup. Top with 60ml soda water, stir and add a grapefruit wedge.
